data.gist: Micronized bone marrow reduced knee swelling versus BMAC at 4 weeks and versus PBS at 4 and 8 weeks; BMAC did not differ from PBS.
data.plain: Joint swelling, gauged by comparing knee width of the operated and unoperated legs, was lower with the micronized bone marrow than with saline at both timepoints and lower than BMAC at 4 weeks. BMAC itself did not significantly reduce swelling compared with saline.
